claims.claim_vi: The source lists four high-level components of a possible experiment platform, taken from the book Trustworthy Online Controlled Experiments: experiment definition, setup and management via a UI stored in the experiment system configuration; experiment deployment to server and client side including variant assignment and parameterization; experiment instrumentation; experiment analysis.
claims.verified_by: Source body read at the pinned commit.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, 2026-10-19, Python 3 standard library: sha256 of 'experiment:user' modulo 1000 assigned 100,000 users 50,190 to A and 49,810 to B; repeat calls were stable; two experiments with different names gave cells of 25,045 / 25,145 / 24,734 / 25,076, while two with the same name gave only A-A and B-B.
claims.section: Thử nghiệm: chia nhóm bằng băm
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; results copied from output.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, chi-square sample ratio mismatch check at a 50/50 design: 50,190 vs 49,810 gave p about 0.23; 50,400 vs 49,600 gave p about 0.011; 50,000 vs 48,500 gave p about 0.0000018.
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session; results copied from output.

claims.claim_vi: Own experiment, A/A with true rate 10% and 2,000 users per arm: the two-proportion z-test at p < 0.05 reported a difference in 48 of 1,000 runs; looking ten times (every 500 per arm up to 5,000) and stopping at the first p < 0.05 gave 83 of 500; with a true lift 10% to 11% it detected 47 of 300 at 2,000 per arm and 269 of 300 at 20,000 per arm.
claims.verified_by: Script run in the session with a fixed random seed; results copied from output.

claims.claim_vi: The explanation of hash-based assignment, sample ratio mismatch and peeking is the author's general knowledge of online experimentation, not matched against the book.
claims.verified_by: Author's general knowledge, not checked against the primary document in this session (the egress proxy allows GitHub only).

design_notes_vi: Khung một là bốn bước của nền tảng; khung hai là ba chỗ dễ sai. Ba thí nghiệm nằm trong bài.
source_deviations: The source only lists four components; the lesson keeps them and adds three experiments (hash assignment, sample ratio mismatch, peeking).
The book the source quotes was not available in this session, so the extra statements are the author's own and are labelled so.
